visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a title card displaying the orange logo of 'CAMPFIRE' centered against a backdrop of blurry green forest foliage drenched in rain. Large, vibrant green leaves of coniferous-like trees sway gently as raindrops fall through the frame, creating a serene and damp natural environment that sets a calm, atmospheric tone for the outdoor setting. (2) A man in dark camping attire—a black North Face jacket, tactical brown trousers, and rugged hiking boots—is seen in a medium shot squatting on a gravel-covered campsite under the shelter of a large grey tent. He unrolls a black storage bag on the ground, revealing a folded metal fire pit and grill accessories, which he then begins to assemble methodically on a black metal base plate, showing careful preparation. (3) In a series of close-up shots, the man uses a fixed-blade knife and a cylindrical wooden mallet to split small blocks of light-colored wood into thinner tinder sticks on a small wooden cutting board. He carefully stacks these pieces in a precise crisscross 'log cabin' structure inside the black metal fire pit, focusing on the arrangement to ensure proper airflow for the upcoming fire. (4) The camera focuses on the man's hands as he uses the knife to shave thin, curly strips of wood from a larger piece, creating a small pile of flammable shavings on the board. He then produces a ferrocerium rod and strikes it repeatedly with the back of his knife, producing bright sparks that shower onto the wood shavings until a small flame catches, demonstrating survival skills. (5) Using two thin sticks like tongs, the man carefully lifts the burning wood shavings and places them into the center of the pre-arranged wood stack in the fire pit. The fire begins to spread to the larger sticks, glowing with a warm orange light that contrasts with the cool, dim tones of the rainy forest background, as the video concludes with the fire burning steadily and providing warmth.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: One male camper is the sole human presence throughout the video.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A man wearing a black outdoor jacket, dark brown cargo pants, and hiking boots, equipped with a watch on a paracord bracelet.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A wet, gravel-covered campsite situated in a lush green forest during a rainstorm, featuring a large grey tarp-style tent and minimal camping furniture.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a steady, high-frequency white noise texture of rainfall hitting forest leaves, creating a wide spectral atmosphere. This is immediately joined by a soft, melodic acoustic guitar track playing a major-key chord progression at a slow tempo of approximately 80 BPM, establishing a calm and reflective tone for the listeners. (2) A new phase is triggered by the crisp, mid-frequency rustling of a heavy-duty plastic or nylon bag as it is unrolled. This is followed by a series of distinct metallic clinks and dull thuds with short spectral bandwidth as metal fire pit components are placed onto the gravel-covered ground, indicating the start of the meticulous camp setup. (3) This phase begins with sharp, percussive wood-on-wood impacts as a mallet strikes a knife handle. Each hit produces a resonant, high-amplitude transient followed by the crisp, high-frequency splintering sound of wood grain being split apart. The BGM remains a soft, consistent background layer under these sharp incidental wood-splitting noises. (4) A rhythmic, low-level scraping sound of metal against wood is heard as shavings are created. This transition triggers a new phase characterized by rapid, high-frequency metallic 'zips' and scraping sounds as a ferro rod is struck. The BGM shifts slightly as a soft piano melody joins the guitar, increasing the harmonic depth and complexity. (5) A subtle 'whoosh' sound marks the ignition of the shavings, followed by the low-frequency crackle of wood catching fire. The fire's acoustic signature evolves into a steady, crackling texture with frequent mid-to-high frequency pops, blending perfectly with the ongoing rain noise and the gentle, uplifting major-mode BGM to finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Preparation -> Execution -> Climax -> Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video provides a high-fidelity sensory and ASMR experience of building a campfire during a rainstorm. It emphasizes technical skill and gear usage, implicitly promoting the 'CAMPFIRE' brand by associating it with a serene, professional, and relaxing outdoor lifestyle.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The prominent placement of the brand logo 'CAMPFIRE' at the start and the focus on branded gear throughout the process.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes high-quality ambient nature sounds and crisp foley effects to drive an immersive narrative without any spoken dialogue.
